title: 第七章 瞎瘠乱想第八章 孝子贤孙
content_zh:
;;
“咳咳。”
瞅见秦尧的眉头一皱再皱，九叔着实担心他当场发飙，令任家下不来台，连忙咳嗽两声，将众人的目光重新拉回自己身上：“还未自我介绍，我叫林九，他是我三徒弟秦尧。”
任发瞪了少女一眼，示意她不要乱说话，随即脸上堆满笑容，朝着九叔拱手：“不好意思九叔，在下任发，旁边的这位是小女婷婷。她刚从国外回来，学了洋鬼子那套快人快语，希望你多多包涵。”（ps：原著中说是在省城学化妆，没说在哪里读书，也没提留学的事情，剧情需要，稍加改编……）
九叔摆了摆手，笑道：“任老爷言重了，只是认错人而已，又不是什么大事儿。”
任发目含赞赏，夸道：“不愧是有口皆碑的九叔，就是大气。任全，去准备最高级别的午宴，今日我要与九叔不醉不归。”
“不必了。”任全还未来得及回应，九叔便拒绝道：“任老爷，林九喝不了酒，所以这酒宴就不用了，我们还是直接说事吧。”
任发眼眸转动了一下，道：“好吧，实不相瞒，今日请九叔过来，是为了给我爹迁坟一事。”
“好端端的，为何要迁坟？”九叔不解地问道。
任发道：“此事说来话长……十多年前，我爹病重弥留之际，我为其找了一块风水宝地，又让一位风水先生将那宝地改成了蜻蜓点水穴，聚拢福气。头些年没什么感觉，这几年我家的生意却越亏越严重，气运越来越薄弱，我就怀疑是不是这坟出了什么问题。”
九叔身后，秦尧心中一动：主线剧情到底还是受到了波及，第一个蝴蝶效应出现了。
在原著中，应该是那建立坟墓的风水先生要求任发二十年后起棺迁葬，现实却变成了任发自己想要起棺迁葬。
看起来这两者间的关系不过是一个被动一个主动，实际上差之毫厘，谬以千里，未来因为这道裂缝而产生的变数足以更改结局！
“事不宜迟，我们这就赶往任老太爷的安眠之处吧。”九叔道。
九叔发话了，任发也没什么意见，于是任全便安排下人抬来几个无盖软座，恭请任发、任婷婷，以及九叔上座。
“任老爷，这座子……”九叔伸手指了指座子开口。
“师父，您坐就好，我们不需要。”
秦尧一边说着，一边拽着九叔来到座子旁，轻声耳语：“师父，你怎么在这个时候糊涂了？你不上座的话，任家人好意思坐吗？”
九叔：“……”
在这一刻，他忽然明白了，秦尧不是不懂人情世故，而是不想被人情世故困住。

反正对于秦尧来说，拳头是可以成为真理的，如果一拳不行的话，那么就两拳！
可他林九不行。
经受传统教育的他做不到枉顾世俗规则，于是自己这名心比天高的徒弟便俯下身来，融入世俗，为他查遗补漏。
念及此处，可把林九感动坏了，满怀欣慰的拍了拍秦尧臂膀，说道：“坐，师父坐。”
秦尧：“……”
怎么突然感觉这老头有点怪怪的？
他是不是瞎瘠薄想啥了？
“师弟，你觉得这任小姐漂不漂亮？”路上，秋生频频看向坐在软座上的任婷婷，眼睛都快看直了。

"Ahem."
Seeing Qin Yao's brows wrinkled again and again, Uncle Jiu was really worried that he would go crazy on the spot and prevent the Ren family from getting off the stage. He coughed twice and drew everyone's attention back to him: "I haven't introduced myself yet, my name is Lin Jiu, and he is my third apprentice Qin Yao."
Ren Fa glared at the girl and signaled her not to talk nonsense. Then he smiled with a smile on his face and raised his hand to Uncle Jiu: "I'm sorry, Uncle Jiu, I'm Ren Fa. This is my little girl Tingting next to me. She just came back from abroad and learned the foreign devils' quick talk. I hope you'll bear with me." (PS: The original book said that she was studying makeup in a provincial capital. It didn't say where she studied, nor did she mention studying abroad. The plot needs to be slightly adapted...)
Uncle Jiu waved his hand and said with a smile: "Master Ren is serious, it's just that he admitted the wrong person, it's not a big deal."
Ren Fa looked at him with admiration and praised: "As expected of the well-known Uncle Ninth, he is so grand. Ren Quan, go prepare for the highest level luncheon. Today I will not get drunk with Uncle Ninth."
"No need." Before Ren Quan could respond, Uncle Jiu refused: "Master Ren, Lin Jiu can't drink, so there is no need for this banquet. Let's just talk about things directly."
Ren Fa rolled his eyes and said, "Okay, to be honest, I invited Uncle Jiu here today to move my father's grave."
"It's so good, why do you want to move the grave?" Uncle Jiu asked puzzledly.
Ren Fa said: "It's a long story... More than ten years ago, when my father was seriously ill and dying, I found a Feng Shui treasure land for him, and asked a Feng Shui master to change the treasure land into a dragonfly point water hole to gather blessings. In the first few years, I didn't feel anything. In the past few years, my family's business has been suffering more and more serious losses, and my luck has become weaker and weaker. I wondered if there was something wrong with this tomb."
After Uncle Jiu's death, Qin Yao's heart moved: the main plot was still affected after all, and the first butterfly effect appeared.
In the original work, it was the Feng Shui master who built the tomb who asked Ren Fa to lift the coffin and bury him twenty years later, but the reality turned out to be that Ren Fa himself wanted to lift the coffin and bury him.
It seems that the relationship between the two is just a passive one and an active one. In fact, the difference is just a hair's breadth, a thousand miles away. The variables caused by this crack in the future are enough to change the outcome!
"Without further delay, let's rush to the resting place of Mr. Ren." Uncle Jiu said.
Uncle Jiu had spoken, but Ren Fa had no objection, so Ren Quan arranged for his servants to bring a few soft seats without covers, and respectfully invited Ren Fa, Ren Tingting, and Uncle Jiu to sit down.
"Master Ren, this house..." Uncle Jiu pointed at the seat and spoke.
"Master, just sit down, we don't need it."
As Qin Yao spoke, he dragged Uncle Jiu to the seat and whispered softly: "Master, why are you confused at this time? If you don't take the seat, will your family have the nerve to sit down?"
Uncle Jiu: "..."
At this moment, he suddenly understood that it was not that Qin Yao did not understand the world, but that he did not want to be trapped by the world.
Anyway, for Qin Yao, fists can become the truth. If one punch doesn't work, then two punches!
But Lin Jiu can't.
Having received traditional education, he could not ignore the secular rules, so he, his lofty-minded disciple, leaned down and blended into the secular world to check for his omissions.
Thinking of this, Lin Jiu was so moved that she patted Qin Yao's arm with relief and said, "Sit down, master."
Qin Yao: "..."
Why do you suddenly feel that this old man is a little weird?
Is he thinking blindly?
"Junior brother, do you think this young lady is pretty?" On the way, Qiu Sheng frequently looked at Ren Tingting, who was sitting on the soft seat, and his eyes almost went straight.
